basic_extensions.material: repeated valueReference.reference in original materials order
basic_extensions.episode-id: optional opaque valueString; no other Episode data
basic_extensions.questionnaire-canonical-json: valueString: json.dumps(resource,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False), exact UTF8 hash serialization helper. Parse and semantic-compare with visible Questionnaire, preserve original number lexemes for packet hash; contains only the same permitted Questionnaire.

document_reference.identifier: one identifier: system canonical_base + '/identifier/material', value material_id
document_reference.content: one attachment with exactly contentType text/plain;charset=utf-8 and canonical base64 data for nonempty permitted UTF-8 text; for empty text exactly contentType and size:0 without data (FHIR forbids empty primitives). No URL or Attachment.hash.

questionnaire: Original frozen Questionnaire resource, unchanged; validate form supported-subset and hash
integrity: Reconstruct FrozenCheckpointPacket; validate all packet, material, clinical-content and questionnaire bindings; encode again and require exact JSON-object equality including entry/extension order. Unknown properties, resources, extensions, duplicate refs and external content are rejected.
limits: Content hashes are binding/integrity checks, not signatures or proof of clinical correctness. Import requires independently trusted packet manifest to establish assignment authenticity.
